items.headline: Mitsubishi Electric's PCI deal stirs ETRM M&A
items.summary: Commentary following Mitsubishi Electric's acquisition of PCI Energy Solutions is prompting ETRM and CTRM vendor owners to reassess valuations and consolidation strategy across the sector.

items.headline: BRAC Bank goes live with Finastra trade platform
items.summary: BRAC Bank in Bangladesh launched a digital trade finance platform combining Finastra's Trade Innovation and Corporate Channels with Conpend's Trade AI tools to unify previously fragmented corporate trade processes.

items.headline: Container freight rates hit 15-week high
items.summary: Drewry's World Container Index rose to a 15-week high, driven by sharp increases on Asia-Europe lanes, as carriers cancel sailings and tanker traffic near Hormuz faces continued disruption and longer routing.

items.headline: ACER updates REMIT-EMIR reporting overlap rules
items.summary: ACER is revising guidance on which energy derivative trades must be reported under REMIT versus EMIR following the 2024 REMIT revision, aiming to cut duplicate reporting and improve EU-wide data consistency.
